question:
In parallelogram FIST, find ∠STO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb7c883acdb1d9744b66c7260485beddad7528355ca286d648f80271d6e9cd98.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In **parallelogram FIST**, the opposite sides **FI** and **TS** are parallel (FI || TS).

When diagonal **IT** acts as a **transversal**, the **alternate interior angles** are equal.

∴ ∠STO = ∠FIT = 35°.

**∴ The correct answer is 35°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ **FIST** is a **parallelogram**.

⇒ Diagonals **FS** and **IT** intersect at **O**.

⇒ In a parallelogram, opposite sides are **parallel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/344b3d5b1c9a54dd5d51371d88452d7098c141d31ed5311253aa9b6811a2948b.png] 

**Formula/Property Used:**

⇒ **Alternate Interior Angles:** When two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, the alternate interior angles are equal.

**Calculations:**

⇒ In parallelogram **FIST**, side **FI** is parallel to side **TS** (FI || TS).

⇒ The diagonal **IT** acts as a transversal line cutting through **FI** and **TS**.

⇒ ∠FIT and ∠STO are **alternate interior angles**.

⇒ Since alternate interior angles are equal, ∠STO = ∠FIT.

⇒ Given the geometry of the parallelogram and the standard diagonal relationship, ∠FIT = 35°.

⇒ ∴ ∠STO = 35°.

**∴ The correct answer is 35°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Diagonal Bisector Property

The diagonals of a **parallelogram** bisect each other, meaning the intersection point **O** is the midpoint of both **FS** and **IT**.

Consecutive Interior Angles

The sum of consecutive interior angles in a parallelogram is always **180°** (e.g., ∠FTS + ∠TSI = 180°).

Opposite Angle Property

Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal (∠FIS = ∠FTS and ∠IFT = ∠IST).</p
